data.one_liner: Control USB UVC cameras for live preview, capture, recording, and raw frames.
data.what_it_does: Allows connecting to one or several USB UVC cameras to stream live video onto a Flutter Texture, take JPEG pictures, record MP4 videos, read raw RGBA frames, and adjust camera settings.
use_when: You need to connect external USB webcams or UVC cameras to a Flutter app.
You require raw frame access from a UVC camera for custom processing or ML.
You want to control camera settings like focus, pan, and tilt programmatically.
avoid_when: You only need the built-in device cameras rather than external USB UVC cameras.
You are developing for a platform not supported by the package.
strengths: Provides raw frame access, picture capture, and MP4 video recording.
Includes stall detection, auto-recovery, and stream diagnostics.
weaknesses: Requires specific platform setups for permissions and device access on Linux and macOS.
Video recording is not supported on Linux.
data.setup_notes: Android requires USB permissions. macOS requires Info.plist and entitlements configuration for camera access. Linux requires appropriate permissions for camera device nodes.

alternatives.name: camera
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick this if you need to use built-in mobile/desktop cameras rather than external USB UVC cameras.
